notes: Sprint 4 of 4. Delivers renewal with grace-period lapse (AC-07), simulated premium payments (AC-17), an idempotent end-of-day cycle (AC-18), cancellation with pro-rata and free-look refunds (AC-08, AC-19), the admin portfolio dashboard (AC-20), seed data with three products and sample policies (≥70% auto-bind), the README quick-start, and the Playwright end-to-end journeys with committed snapshots at 1280px and 390px (AC-24). Refunds, payments and transitions are append-only (NFR-02); every amount is Decimal quantized once (NFR-01). TDD: failing test before implementation for every story.
